name: VisitAPI Framework
teaser: Recreating Storyline and Dialog feature from the Offcial to SPT. Easy to apply to native or custom Trader with a sign file.
description:
DESCRIPTION

⚠️ 1.1 STORYLINE AND QUEST NOT INCLUDED. BUT YOU CAN FOUND THEM IN ADDON.

What is this?

VisitAPI is a Frameworks that brings EFT 1.0-Style Storyline and Trader Dialog featrue to SPT. Write a simple .DLG script and apply the script to the trader that you want to have STORYLINE, DIALOG features.

Trader that apply with the script will have the same perform as EFT 1.0-Style with custom made 3D Scence/ Picture/ Video/ BGM/ Vocal as the background elements with custom made StoryChatper. All these can be config or edit with the VisitAPI Editor

How to use?

The API doesn’t ship with any content. You will need to create your own .DLG script either by hand or stop surffing yourself with looking the doc example in Github wondering why is not working. instead using the VisitAPI Editor for Dialog, Quest, Storyline design.

Once the .DLG file is place in the BepInEx\config\VisitAPI folder. The Trader will appear a VISIT Button and Story Chapter like official did.

How to Install?

  1. Extract the archive into your SPT root (the folder with SPT.Server.exe).

  2. Put your scripts in BepInEx\config\VisitAPI.

    Backgrounds go in BepInEx\config\VisitAPI\backgrounds\

    Vocal and music go in BepInEx\config\VisitAPI\audio\.

  3. Double-click VisitAPI.Editor.exe in the SPT root — it opens a web base app that allow you to edit your dlg file.

  4. Optional: VisitAPI EFT11.zip adds some official Stroyline. Can be found in addons.

🙏 Credits

Shout out Qwertyalex from WTT and 7Bpencil for the 1.1 storyline dump.

Bug or contribution? Leave an Issue here or GitHub.

KNOWING ISSUE

Lack some features from 1.0

The Plugin is not 100% cover all the feature that is in 1.0. Is still under develpment.
